policy.authority: This file is the only registry of Frames tool IDs and their contracts. Application code, the acquisition scripts (scripts/frames-refresh) and the Lambo pipeline (scripts/lambo) refer to capabilities by key (for example pump.coin) and resolve the tool ID here. Research universe and narrative rules live in docs/prompts/refresh-market-data.sources.json; cadence, scope, budget, pagination and freshness live in docs/data/jobs.json.

statuses.validated: Descriptor verified, at least one live response retained, adapter registered and its field map verified against that response. May be enabled.
statuses.candidate: Descriptor verified (free frames_get_tool) but no live response has been retained or the field map is unverified. Never enabled; never published.
statuses.discovered: Seen in free search results only. No adapter. Not callable by any job.
statuses.blocked: Tested and failed for a documented reason. Do not pay again until the reason has changed.
statuses.deprecated: Replaced; kept for provenance of old observations.

policy.enableRule: enabled=true requires validation.status=validated, a registered adapter (src/lib/lambo/adapters/registry.ts) and validation.fieldMapVerified=true. scripts/lambo/providers.ts validate enforces this.
policy.rights: storage, display and redistribution are recorded per capability. 'unknown' blocks paid API export of components derived from that capability (src/lib/lambo/api/rights.ts); it does not block collection, retention of evidence the repository already retains, or unrelated work. Values change only after the owner reviews the provider's terms.
policy.searchIds: attribution.searchId is the last Frames search that led to a tool. It is passed to frames_invoke_tools for attribution only; it is not an identifier and may be replaced at any time.
policy.prices: payment.priceHintUsd is the catalog hint, not a binding quote. Quote with frames_probe_tools (free) before a paid batch; the bill is the run's billing block in credits.
